title: BTS take Artist of the Year and Album of the Year at the Melon Music Awards
dek: The Melon Music Awards are one of South Korea's main music prizes. BTS won two of the five grand prizes across the two nights.
what: The Melon Music Awards 2026 were held on 14 and 15 November at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul. The Korea Times reports that BTS and aespa took grand prizes on the opening night.

Soompi reports BTS won Album of the Year on the first night for ARIRANG, and Artist of the Year and Best Group on the second night. It counts six awards for BTS over the two nights. Soompi lists the other grand prizes: aespa won the new Global K-Artist of the Year, IVE won Song of the Year and CORTIS won Record of the Year.

BTS's official account posted a thank-you to its fans, called ARMY, with the hashtag #MMA2026. Replies came in Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Indonesian and English. I relied on the Soompi and Korea Times reports; I did not see the ceremony.
why: Fans of a large group share every win within minutes, so the thank-you post gathers replies in many languages while the result is still new.
